rationale: The openlit->OTEL migration has already landed, so this is an enrichment run over existing telemetry code: locate the OTEL exporter/meter wiring and the metric names+attributes it emits, then map them onto the already-running parrot-prometheus/parrot-grafana stack and the example dashboard JSON. Wiki queries are run as free orientation alongside these (the plan schema's type enum predates the wiki query types).

queries.intent: Locate the parrot observability/telemetry package and its OTEL entrypoints
Find every OTEL metric instrument name emitted (counters/histograms) to know what the dashboard can query
Find the metric attribute keys (agent name, model, provider) attached to those instruments
Confirm residual openlit references — whether the migration is complete or partial
Enumerate the env/.env* files and the OTEL-related variables they already define
Find where those env vars are read (navconfig settings) to know the authoritative variable names
Read the observability module's main file(s) in full to understand exporter selection and export protocol
Locate cost-tracking code — whether cost is computed in-process and emitted as a metric or must be derived in PromQL
Locate the existing example Grafana dashboard JSON files that must be updated
Inspect the Grafana provisioning tree (datasources + dashboard providers) on the running stack
Read the prometheus docker-compose to learn container names, network, ports and OTLP receiver flags
Read the grafana docker-compose + README for the running parrot-grafana container contract
Find any pre-existing observability compose stack that the example dashboard shipped with
Check recent git activity on the observability/telemetry source tree to date the migration
Check git history of the docker prometheus/grafana stack to see what it was built for
Find existing observability documentation that must be kept in sync
Find tests covering the telemetry layer, to know the existing test contract
Determine whether metrics are pushed via OTLP or pulled via a /metrics scrape endpoint
Check whether prior SDD work already specified this observability migration
Locate the aiohttp server hook that would expose a scrape endpoint if the pull model is used

expected_findings: Exact module path of the OTEL telemetry layer and its public API
The concrete metric instrument names and their attribute keys (agent, model, provider)
Whether export is push (OTLP) or pull (Prometheus scrape) — decides the .env variables and whether an otel-collector is needed
Whether cost is emitted as a metric or must be computed in PromQL from token counts
The path of the example Grafana dashboard JSON and how Grafana provisioning picks it up
The running parrot-prometheus/parrot-grafana container names, network and ports
